all_controls.description: Every control enabled: shipped pipeline plus isolation and redaction.

anomaly_only.description: Anomaly scorer alone; alert-only telemetry, never blocks.

canonicalization_only.description: Canonicalization alone; its signal is text normalization (e.g. zero-width removal).

canonicalization_plus_filter.description: Canonicalization preprocessing combined with the context filter.

default_pipeline.description: Shipped DefensePipeline: canonicalization + filter + anomaly + uncertainty.

defense_off.description: No controls: raw exposure of the simulated pipeline.

filter_only.description: Context filter alone on raw text (no canonicalization preprocessing).

isolation_only.description: Context isolation alone; tamper detection requires session state, so single-turn cases are expected to yield no detections.

redaction_only.description: Content redaction alone; hygiene control measured by redaction activity.

uncertainty_only.description: Uncertainty scorer alone; routes to human review, never blocks.

disclaimer: Simulation-only ablation over the deterministic heuristic pipeline and governed baseline_v2 corpus. These numbers measure control contribution inside this lab harness and are not production-efficacy claims.
